gloss: to accept; to resign oneself to; to content oneself with

definitions.gloss: to accept; to resign oneself to; to submit to
definitions.explanation: To accept an unfavorable situation or outcome without resistance. Implies a passive acceptance of something undesirable, often because one feels powerless to change it or considers it deserved.

definitions.gloss: to content oneself with; to settle for
definitions.explanation: To be satisfied with less than what might be desired or expected. Often used with a critical nuance, suggesting the person should aspire to more.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧ (sweet, lenient). The verb conveys the idea of passively accepting something, as though yielding to sweetness or leniency. Most commonly appears in the pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{甘|あま}んじる. The older form {甘|あま}んずる also exists but is rare in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{甘|あま}んじる: to accept punishment
- ⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{甘|あま}んじる: to settle for the status quo
- ⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{甘|あま}んじる: to accept defeat
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{甘|あま}んじる: to accept criticism
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{甘|あま}んじて⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない: must not settle for ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to accept — neutral; simply means to accept without the nuance of resignation
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}する→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧: to endure, put up with — emphasizes tolerating something unpleasant through willpower
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up — focuses on abandoning hope, while {甘|あま}んじる focuses on accepting a lesser outcome
